This page contains a history of all released versions of the Google Publisher Tag
(GPT) library. The version numbers provided correspond to the
number you may see in the name of the `pubads_impl*.js` file.

As GPT releases are rolled out gradually to users in stages,
the version date reflects when the staged roll out of a release began, while
release date reflects when the release was rolled out to the majority of users.

For information on major, user-visible changes to GPT, see the
[release notes](https://developers.google.com/publisher-tag/release-notes).
